entry.label: Linear elasticity · drained compression
entry.description: 1% drained axial compression in 100 increments from explicit 100 kPa isotropic effective stress and void ratio 0.7. Constant elastic stiffness gives reversible stress changes; this monotonic path does not demonstrate yielding or cyclic soil behaviour. Parameters illustrate the equation response and are not a specimen calibration.

entry.label: Drucker–Prager · drained compression
entry.description: 1% drained axial compression in 100 increments from explicit 100 kPa isotropic effective stress and void ratio 0.7. Pressure-dependent perfect plasticity with nonassociated flow. This example uses the smooth-cone/apex model without a separate tensile cutoff or hardening. Parameters illustrate the equation response and are not a specimen calibration.

entry.label: Modified Cam Clay · drained compression
entry.description: 1% drained axial compression in 100 increments from explicit 100 kPa isotropic effective stress and void ratio 0.7. Pressure-dependent yielding and evolving preconsolidation pressure. The explicit initial preconsolidation pressure is 200 kPa at 100 kPa isotropic effective stress; the exponential finite-step hardening is the atlas discretization. Parameters illustrate the equation response and are not a specimen calibration.

entry.label: Hypoplastic sand 1996 · drained compression
entry.description: 1% drained axial compression in 100 increments from explicit 100 kPa isotropic effective stress and void ratio 0.7. Stress and density dependent sand response from the specified void ratio. This monotonic path does not establish cyclic or small-strain behaviour. Parameters illustrate the equation response and are not a specimen calibration.

entry.label: Hypoplastic sand with IGS · drained compression
entry.description: 1% drained axial compression in 100 increments from explicit 100 kPa isotropic effective stress and void ratio 0.7. Sand response with intergranular-strain history, initialized to zero. This monotonic path does not test reversal stiffness; the implementation includes its documented history cap and admission band. Parameters illustrate the equation response and are not a specimen calibration.
